subject: APAC / EMEA cohort commit + coverage handoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@astradata.com>, procurement@astradata.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 09:15:00 +0100
Subject: APAC / EMEA cohort commit + coverage handoff

Tom / procurement team —

Following our call this morning, attaching the suggested commit matrix and a short handoff plan for coverage across APAC and EMEA during the final approval window. Goal: lock committed ARR for Q3 by COB APAC Wednesday (2028-07-03). Key asks below — please confirm by EOD APAC Tuesday if you can:

- Confirm final committed ARR number and primary billing contact (we need exact PO line to route invoices).
- Confirm whether procurement requires redline on the SOW or if signature-only is fine.
- Any final compliance evidence needed (SOC2 artifact or regional DPA) — we can fast-track.

Attachments: astradata-commit-matrix-20280701.xlsx (proposed stage / owner assignments), pricing-exception-request.pdf (requested 10% promotional credit for volume).

Internal notes: Laura, Monica — once Tom confirms, please prepare the invoice schedule and route through finance. Rishi — ops will need the coverage rotation (APAC nights) for the 1-week onboarding window.

Tom — high level commit proposed in the matrix: APAC cohort (Singapore, Sydney) 850k ARR; EMEA bridge 420k ARR (partial). If that aligns, we’ll prepare the final DocuSign and mark as committed in the forecast.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@astradata.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@astradata.com, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 23:10:00 +0800
Subject: Re: APAC / EMEA cohort commit + coverage handoff

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear playbook and the matrix. Quick answers:

- Committed ARR: we can confirm 1,230,000 USD total (SG/SYD 850k + EMEA 380k confirmed). We need the invoice to show two line items (APAC managed services / EMEA connectors) for our internal allocation.
- Procurement: signature-only on the SOW is acceptable; procurement will generate the PO after signature. I’ve looped the procurement alias on this thread.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II and our regional DPA checklist are sufficient; no additional evidence needed.

I can sign the DocuSign as soon as you push it — target to sign by EOD APAC Tuesday. One ask: can the promotional credit be applied on month 1 rather than as a retrospective credit? That simplifies our accounting.

Tom
Tom Chen
Head of Cloud Procurement
Astra Data Systems
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: APAC / EMEA cohort commit + coverage handoff

Aditya / team — noted. A couple of operational points before we push DocuSign: 

- Pricing exception: finance will approve a 10% promotional credit but only if applied on first invoice as Tom requested; we’ll record the promo as a line-level credit and attach the approval memo.
- Invoice lines: ops needs exact GL breakdown for the two line items — Aditya, please confirm labels to match Astra’s cost centers.
- PO timing: ask procurement to attach the PO number in the DocuSign signature form so our billing system can auto-match.

I’ll shepherd the invoice and queue it for Monday billing if we have PO and signed DocuSign by Wednesday morning in APAC.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@astradata.com>, procurement@astradata.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jul 2028 07:45:00 +0800
Subject: Re: APAC / EMEA cohort commit + coverage handoff

Thanks all — quick recap and final actions: 

- Confirmed committed ARR: 1,230,000 USD (APAC 850k / EMEA 380k). I’ll update the forecast and tag this as Q3 committed.
- Pricing credit: approved to apply on first invoice = 10% line-level credit.
- DocuSign: I’m pushing the envelope now with the PO field visible for procurement to populate. Link: https://www.docusign.com/ASTRA-EXCEPTIONS/12345
- Attachments: final commit matrix (astradata-commit-matrix-20280701.xlsx) updated with invoice labels.
- Ops: Rishi, please schedule APAC coverage rotation Tuesday night -> Saturday morning for the 7-day onboarding window. 

Tom — please confirm when you’ve signed and provide the PO number so Laura can cut the invoice. Once PO is attached we’ll mark this closed in the regional forecast.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Aditya
